name: esp_audio_capture_service_apply_setup
description: Configure audio capture streams, codecs, and optional muxer settings before start

fixed_src_sample_rate.description: Optional source sample-rate pin in Hz; 0 leaves unset

streams.description: One or two output stream configurations

enabled.description: Whether the stream is enabled after setup; defaults to true

codec.description: Audio codec FourCC string such as 'AAC ', 'PCM ', 'ALAW', 'OPUS'

bitrate.description: Encoded bitrate in bit/s; 0 if unused

muxer_type.description: Optional muxer FourCC such as 'MP4 ', 'WAV '; omit for none

auto_record.description: Enable muxer automatically after capture starts

streaming.description: Keep muxed output available for streaming

name: esp_audio_capture_service_enable_stream
description: Enable or disable one output stream

enable.description: true to enable, false to disable

name: esp_audio_capture_service_start_record
description: Start recording on a stream with a preconfigured storage muxer

name: esp_audio_capture_service_set_storage_url
description: Set or clear the manual storage URL for a stream

url.description: Storage URL; omit or empty to clear

name: esp_audio_capture_service_get_last_storage_url
description: Get the most recently generated recording URL for a stream

name: esp_audio_capture_service_get_storage_file_info
description: Stat a recorded storage file and return size, mtime, and ctime. Omit url to use the stream last storage URL.

stream.description: Stream ID used when resolving the last storage URL; defaults to 0

url.description: Absolute file path to query; omit to use last storage URL

name: esp_audio_capture_service_get_status
description: Get the audio capture service state and name
